TcX Support for New Product Introduction

A primary value\-add of Teamcenter is its high integration capability and extensibility\. Customers are demanding more and more applications working in the context of Teamcenter X including integration such as TCRA, Easy Plan, Geolus for which these teams need environment and necessary support to roll out their solution\.

The document is a formal procedure to outline a working agreement for internal resources that are not in CLOUD\_ART to develop and test their solution on the TcX environment\.

##### Scope

- Grant access and manage the AWS resources on behalf of the other solution teams\.

## <a id="_Toc181705878"></a>Principles

- Least privilege access\.
- Frequent reviews\.
- Existing accounts managed by CLOUD\_ART which are dedicated to supporting other teams shall be used\.

## <a id="_Toc181705881"></a>Procedures

### Common procedures

The requesting team sends an email to the CLOUD\_ART representative\. This email must contain,

- An approval from TcX Product Management to support the NPI
- Details about the product support request\. 
- Limited \(Teamcenter access only\) or Full \(AWS access\)?
- Required timeline

The CLOUD\_ART representative will share a copy of [Teamcenter X NPI Working Agreement Template\.docx](https://siemensnam.sharepoint.com/:w:/r/teams/disw_plc_coi_fdo/cyber/Shared%20Documents/ISMS%20Procedures%20for%20TcX%20Development/Templates/Teamcenter%20X%20NPI%20Working%20Agreement%20Template.docx?d=wd55f41ebe605418689461b12fe9c1b11&csf=1&web=1&e=jVhT8W)

with the requesting team, who will reply with details and agreement\. Approvals and Agreements must be archived in the evidence folder: 

- for 2024: [NPI Working Agreements](https://siemensnam.sharepoint.com/:f:/r/teams/disw_plc_coi_fdo/cyber/Shared%20Documents/ISMS%20Evidence/2024/NPI%20Working%20Agreements?csf=1&web=1&e=3ejSVR) 
- for 2025: [NPI Working Agreements](https://siemensnam.sharepoint.com/:f:/r/teams/disw_plc_coi_fdo/cyber/Shared%20Documents/ISMS%20Evidence/2025/NPI%20Working%20Agreements?csf=1&web=1&e=KhHVpN) 

The CLOUD\_ART representative will add task to their team to delete the environment at the agreed time\.

Detailed procedures will then be undertaken\.

### Procedure to support NPI for process\-mode TcX

These are undertaken by the CLOUD\_ART team

__Hosting Account: account 30__

__Procedure:__

1. Pick TcX release version and addon list based on the requirement\.
2. Choose a region \(which is not allocated to any team\) for the deployment from AWS Account 30\.
3. Create a TcX environment by following section “2\.3\.2 Customer deployment” from the version specific cookbook\.  
For TcX8\.2, [https://mypolarion\.industrysoftware\.automation\.siemens\.com/polarion/\#/project/Teamcenter/wiki/TCX%208\_2%20Install%20Documentation/TCX%208\_2%20installation%20Cookbook](https://mypolarion.industrysoftware.automation.siemens.com/polarion/#/project/Teamcenter/wiki/TCX%208_2%20Install%20Documentation/TCX%208_2%20installation%20Cookbook)
4. Once the environment is created, onboard the users by following section “3\.1\.7 End\-users On\-boarding” from the version specific cookbook\.  
For TcX8\.2, [https://mypolarion\.industrysoftware\.automation\.siemens\.com/polarion/\#/project/Teamcenter/wiki/TCX%208\_2%20Install%20Documentation/TCX%208\_2%20installation%20Cookbook](https://mypolarion.industrysoftware.automation.siemens.com/polarion/#/project/Teamcenter/wiki/TCX%208_2%20Install%20Documentation/TCX%208_2%20installation%20Cookbook)
5. \[Optional\] Create a region\-specific AWS role \(federated SAML\) in deployment AWS account to onboard users to the AWS \(federated login\)\.
6. \[Optional\] Onboard the user to AWS account using role created above, based on the requirement\.
7. Drop an email to the stakeholder as below format\.

![](data:image/png;base64,)

__Delete:__

1. Get the confirmation on the deletion of the environment from the requested team\.
2. Upon confirmation, delete the environment by following below cookbook  
[https://mypolarion\.industrysoftware\.automation\.siemens\.com/polarion/\#/project/Teamcenter/wiki/TCX%208\_2%20Install%20Documentation/TCX%208\_2%20Cloud%20Stack%20Deletion%20Instructions%20Set](https://mypolarion.industrysoftware.automation.siemens.com/polarion/#/project/Teamcenter/wiki/TCX%208_2%20Install%20Documentation/TCX%208_2%20Cloud%20Stack%20Deletion%20Instructions%20Set)
3. If users are onboarded to AWS account, offboard the users from the AWS account\.
4. Drop an email to the stakeholder as below format\.

### Procedure to support NPI for cTcX

These are undertaken by the CLOUD\_ART team

__Hosting Account: AWS Account 340__

__Procedure:__

1. Pick cTcX release version and product ID list based on the requirement\.
2. Create a cTcX environment by following section “5\. Tenant Onboarding” from the version specific cookbook\.  
For cTcX 2406, [https://mypolarion\.industrysoftware\.automation\.siemens\.com/polarion/\#/project/Teamcenter/wiki/Project%20Storm/cTcX%20CookBook%202406?selection=LCS\-1041445](https://mypolarion.industrysoftware.automation.siemens.com/polarion/#/project/Teamcenter/wiki/Project%20Storm/cTcX%20CookBook%202406?selection=LCS-1041445)
3. Once the environment is created, onboard the users by following section “5\.7 Create CApS users in Teamcenter” from the version specific cookbook\.  
For cTcX 2406, [https://mypolarion\.industrysoftware\.automation\.siemens\.com/polarion/\#/project/Teamcenter/wiki/Project%20Storm/cTcX%20CookBook%202406?selection=LCS\-1096892](https://mypolarion.industrysoftware.automation.siemens.com/polarion/#/project/Teamcenter/wiki/Project%20Storm/cTcX%20CookBook%202406?selection=LCS-1096892)
4. \[Optional\] Create an AWS role \(federated SAML\) for us\-east\-1 region in deployment AWS account to onboard users to the AWS \(federated login\) – one time activity\. The role name is awspdproject 340\_webkey\_tcx\_nca\.
5. \[Optional\] Onboard the user to AWS account using the above\-mentioned role, based on the requirement\.
6. Drop an email to the stakeholder in the format provided below\.
